Title: Lot of questions without logic chain

Messages.Author: akais...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
I have some questions that I really want to solve, please, help me !

1- Crusher - This old warrior is really misleading becouse of his
unique ability to "burn one blood to get one dodge"...is this dodge a
free not-strike special effect or is simply a different version of
Melek's and Bronween special ability ? I mean: if Salinger strike to
Crusher, what really happen ?
Does Crusher pay one blood to dodge the strike and strike back for
free ? or do crusher need a additional strike card to do so (like
Bronween)?

2- Telepatic Tracking - The text is confusing...do T.T.superior work
just as a "not-counterpressable press to continue" or like a "psike!"
clone to restart combat before it ends (or a S:CE resolve) ?

3- Kraken's Kiss 1 - Does the superior KK let you choose
between "strike: strenght+1 ranged" and "steal 2 blood ranged", or it
grant the vampire a sort of "additional strike" to do both ?

4- Kraken's Kiss 2 - If a vampire successfully steal blood and use the
stolen blood to heal wounds...is the healed damage still piling toward
the "3 damage per combat = torpor" effect ?
And using "Taste of Vitae" ?

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

Messages.Author: cantila
Messages.Body:
In article <8umkcc$486$1...@nnrp1.deja.com>,

akais...@my-deja.com wrote:
> I have some questions that I really want to solve, please, help me !
>
> 1- Crusher - This old warrior is really misleading becouse of his
> unique ability to "burn one blood to get one dodge"...is this dodge a
> free not-strike special effect or is simply a different version of
> Melek's and Bronween special ability ? I mean: if Salinger strike to
> Crusher, what really happen ?
> Does Crusher pay one blood to dodge the strike and strike back for
> free ? or do crusher need a additional strike card to do so (like
> Bronween)?

His dodge is a strike that costs one blood. So cannot play another
strike unless playing additional strike-cards.

>
> 2- Telepatic Tracking - The text is confusing...do T.T.superior work
> just as a "not-counterpressable press to continue" or like a "psike!"
> clone to restart combat before it ends (or a S:CE resolve) ?

It's like a non-counterable press, so no new maneuvers from weapons for
example.

>
> 3- Kraken's Kiss 1 - Does the superior KK let you choose
> between "strike: strenght+1 ranged" and "steal 2 blood ranged", or it
> grant the vampire a sort of "additional strike" to do both ?

I don't have the card in front of me right now, but as I remember it,
you only get the str+1 strike the first round. The next rounds
thereafter you can steal blood as a strike, or strike with something
else of your own choice (but not with the str+1 effect, unless you play
anther Kraken's).

>
> 4- Kraken's Kiss 2 - If a vampire successfully steal blood and use the
> stolen blood to heal wounds...is the healed damage still piling toward
> the "3 damage per combat = torpor" effect ?
> And using "Taste of Vitae" ?

The damage is still piled up since the damage was never prevented. You
just made sure you had the source to pay the damage you received.

1. crusher can burn a blood to dodge as a strike. all dodges are

2. (telepathic tracking) i can't answer that. the rules team will have

preventing it would be a different, of course.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
On Sun, 12 Nov 2000 akais...@my-deja.com wrote:

> I have some questions that I really want to solve, please, help me !
>
> 1- Crusher - This old warrior is really misleading becouse of his
> unique ability to "burn one blood to get one dodge"...is this dodge a
> free not-strike special effect or is simply a different version of
> Melek's and Bronween special ability ? I mean: if Salinger strike to
> Crusher, what really happen ?

A dodge is a strike, but the reminder text to that effect was missing.

> Does Crusher pay one blood to dodge the strike and strike back for
> free ? or do crusher need a additional strike card to do so (like
> Bronween)?

He dodges on the strike he uses the ability for. On any other strike
(such as those generated by additional strikes) he can strike normally.

There is currently no way to do anything like "I dodge and hit you at the
same time".

> 2- Telepatic Tracking - The text is confusing...do T.T.superior work
> just as a "not-counterpressable press to continue" or like a "psike!"
> clone to restart combat before it ends (or a S:CE resolve) ?

It can be used as, for example:

1) A non-counterable press, as combat would be about to end in the press
phase.

2) A way of continuing combat whilst S:CE is ending combat.

> 3- Kraken's Kiss 1 - Does the superior KK let you choose
> between "strike: strenght+1 ranged" and "steal 2 blood ranged", or it
> grant the vampire a sort of "additional strike" to do both ?

It grants you the ability to strike for steal 2 blood, ranged, once . If
you generate your own additional strike, you can use it, or if you go to a
second round of combat, you can use it.

Unless you do either of those, you cannot use it.

> 4- Kraken's Kiss 2 - If a vampire successfully steal blood and use the
> stolen blood to heal wounds...is the healed damage still piling toward
> the "3 damage per combat = torpor" effect ?

It is still damage taken. That you got some extra blood to use to heal
the damage doesn't change the fact that you took damage.

> And using "Taste of Vitae" ?

The damage you took would still be collectable by the opposing vampire by
a Taste of Vitae.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
cantila <rogc...@student.luth.se> wrote:

> akais...@my-deja.com wrote:
> > Does Crusher pay one blood to dodge the strike and strike back for
> > free ? or do crusher need a additional strike card to do so (like
> > Bronween)?
>

> His dodge is a strike that costs one blood. So cannot play another
> strike unless playing additional strike-cards.

Correct. All dodges are strikes.

> > 2- Telepatic Tracking - The text is confusing...do T.T.superior
> > work just as a "not-counterpressable press to continue" or like a

> > "psike!" to restart combat before it ends (or a S:CE resolve) ?

>
> It's like a non-counterable press, so no new maneuvers from weapons
> for example.

Right. But it can be played when the combat is ending prior to
the press step, as well. So it can be used after a S:CE.

> > 3- Kraken's Kiss 1 - Does the superior KK let you choose
> > between "strike: strenght+1 ranged" and "steal 2 blood ranged",
> > or it grant the vampire a sort of "additional strike" to do both?
>

> I don't have the card in front of me right now, but as I remember it,
> you only get the str+1 strike the first round. The next rounds
> thereafter you can steal blood as a strike, or strike with something
> else of your own choice (but not with the str+1 effect, unless you
> play anther Kraken's).

Correct. You can also use the steal blood strike if you gain
additional strikes in the current round.

> > 4- Kraken's Kiss 2 - If a vampire successfully steal blood and
> > use the stolen blood to heal wounds...is the healed damage still
> > piling toward the "3 damage per combat = torpor" effect ?

> > And using "Taste of Vitae" ?
>

> The damage is still piled up since the damage was never prevented. You
> just made sure you had the source to pay the damage you received.

Correct. Gaining blood doesn't reduce the amount of damage done.
